Nice to meet you. I’ve been following your illustrations for a while. I found the characters’ expressive faces so cute that I’d like to make a request.
Could you please draw an illustration of the VTuber Rurino Nemo?

[Reference]
https://x.com/rurino_nemo/status/1711337769946218936
This is a post by Rurino herself showing three-view diagrams.
She has two different outfits, but please use the light blue one.

【Scenario & Composition】
I’ll leave the pose and such up to you.
I’d love it if you could capture a lively, smiling, and playful vibe.

【Intended Use】
Personal viewing, posting on social media
Production of merchandise such as acrylic stands and stickers (for personal use only; I will not distribute or sell them)

Upon delivery, I would appreciate it if you could provide the file in PSD format so that the signature and recipient’s name can be turned on or off as needed.
I would be grateful if you could consider this request. Thank you in advance.

Hi! I absolutely LOVE your style and technique, and I would be really happy to have you illustrate my VTuber!

I’d love the illustration to have a “sketch page” / character sheet feeling, that shows off her personality.
Size: 4:3 vertical

Composition:

On the right, I’d like a full-body illustration. I'm looking for something playful, confident, and clever, sexy.
On the left, I’d like a smaller upper-body/portrait illustration with a more flirty expression.
I’d like the background to remain simple and clean, so the focus stays entirely on the character.

Her personality is a mix of illustrator, gamer, flirty girl, and a little bit of “mom” energy. I’d love the expressions and poses to reflect that playful, confident personality.

I’ve included all in the drive folder.
I’m paying a little more than the recommended rate because I understand this involves a bit more work than a standard single illustration.

Thank you so much! I genuinely love your art style ♡

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ztdb7PoqRp4SRWHNXU12YQw_hdSJhQZS?usp=sharing

Hello! I was drawn to your cute art style, so I’d like to make a request.
I’d love for you to illustrate my TRPG character!

▼Character Profile
・Name: Asuka Grange
・16 years old, aspiring idol
・Her family runs a karate dojo; she practices the Gurenji style
・Asuka herself is trained in karate
・She has a cheerful and lively personality and laughs often
・She has good posture and always carries herself with confidence

・Her signature look is a voluminous red ponytail
・She has gold and red odd-colored eyes. She inherited one eye color from her father and the other from her mother, and she really likes them
・She wears white bandages on both hands
・In her pursuit of becoming an idol, she has treated any injuries she could, but faint scars remain on her legs and elsewhere

・Her favorite food is strawberry pudding
・She’s better at dancing than singing. She loves to move her body
・She loves cute things. She used to hesitate about wearing cute items herself, but now she can enjoy them openly

・There are various character illustrations in the reference images, so please feel free to choose the one that resonates with you the most! It’s up to you!
(Files named “Costume ○” contain outfits she wears as an idol.)

▼
I’d like to use the illustrations for non-commercial, personal use on social media and similar platforms.
Thank you for considering this request!

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/4ccl17if1b4n036hn1r33/ABzJ2Ho8KYbCiqbghnWsjZQ?rlkey=ykwclnieqmp0oo2i0qzdpepsu& st=ywmxft9h&dl=0

Nice to meet you! My name is Mii!
I saw the wonderful illustrations by Ore @ Barely Ever Here and thought I’d reach out because I’d really like to commission you.

What I’d like you to draw this time is a single illustration featuring two of my original characters.

〇 Character Details
Miko (the girl with rabbit ears and blonde hair): Detective
Nene (the girl with brown hair): Maid and assistant (cat-themed)

I’ve compiled some reference images in the link below, so please take a look!
There are two outfit options, so I’d be happy if you could choose the one you like best, Ore@Hobo Imasen...! Also, if any parts of the outfits or hairstyles are unclear, feel free to adjust them however you like!

〇Their Relationship
Nene is always being dragged around by Miko’s overly free-spirited behavior, but she’s actually enjoying it in her own way.
They’re very close—they always wear matching hairpins and keychains featuring each other’s motifs!

〇Composition, etc.
I’ll leave it all up to you!
If possible, I’d also love it if you could draw an additional SD illustration of the two of them!

〇 Intended Use
Personal use, such as social media icons, headers, computer wallpapers, or just for my own enjoyment.

I’d really appreciate it if you’d consider this request!

https://photos.app.goo.gl/Te5nX7fPJNmNbAP87

Hello, Ore@Hobo Imasen.

My name is Ayumu Hina, and I’m currently preparing to become a VTuber.
I absolutely love the cute expressions and sparkling eyes in your illustrations, Ore@Hobo Imasen, which is why I’m sending you this request.


[Request Details]
I’d like you to draw an illustration for me to use during my casual chat streams!
(I’d appreciate it if you could draw it in standard color.)

[Intended Uses]
・Social media icons and banners
・Use on sites like LitLink

【Composition】
I’d appreciate a composition where the characters look happy and make eye contact with me,
but I’d like to leave the direction, poses, background, and expressions entirely up to Ore@Hobo Imasen.
Since this will be used for thumbnails, I’d really appreciate it if you could position the characters so their heads and arms aren’t cut off.

【Illustration Format】
・Please provide transparent cutouts of each character only in PSD format.
・It would be helpful if the characters and backgrounds could be delivered on separate layers.
・A landscape image size of 1920×1080 or smaller would be appreciated.

Character Reference:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uJVbyFMO-uIXq0rLmP9Y47rrDuKcGed8/view?usp=drive_link

Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uJVbyFMO-uIXq0rLmP9Y47rrDuKcGed8/view?usp=drive_link

Thank you for your continued support.
My name is Nekasete Kure, an independent VTuber.
Thank you so much for the wonderful, pop, and adorable artwork you created for me the other day! It was so cute—I was absolutely thrilled!
I’m reaching out today to ask if you’d be willing to draw me again.  


♦︎Intended Use (Including commercial use) Icon / Posts on monetized social media / Monetized livestreams / Use in videos and livestreams / Thumbnails / Distribution of wallpapers to listeners as part of subscription services or fan club activities on video streaming sites / 

♦︎ Original Character (OC) I’d Like to Request 
Nekasete Kure (Outfit: Standard Costume)
*For the three-view illustration:
① The pupils of her eyes should be diamond-shaped.
② The fabric on the shoulders of her outfit should be diamond-shaped with no fabric on the first layer and fabric on the second layer.
Please note that this detail may be difficult to understand.
(I apologize for the trouble, but I think it will be easier to understand if you check the first image in the attached files.)

*It would be greatly appreciated if you could include multiple expression variations. ← If the requested fee is insufficient to cover the work involved, please feel free to cancel the request.

♦︎Expressions
Teary-eyed crying face / Beaming smile / Wink / Blushing face / Excited, wide-eyed look / Confused, spinning eyes
*I’d appreciate it if you could choose the ones that are easiest for you to draw from the list above.


・Since this will be used as a thumbnail, I’d appreciate it if you could avoid extremely provocative or bird’s-eye-view compositions.
・For the upper body, it would be very helpful if nothing is cut off from the frame.
 ・If there are backgrounds or signatures (text), I would greatly appreciate it if you could provide the files with these elements on separate layers.
(If possible, I would also appreciate it if you could separate the layer for any glasses.)

I know you’re busy, but thank you for reading this far. 
I would appreciate it if you could take the above points into consideration. Thank you very much for your cooperation.
